decision_conditions: The flat-roofed area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

No window(s) and/or door(s) other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted, including its colour, pointing/bonding shall match those used on the external surfaces of existing building.

The ground floor window serving bedroom 2 of Flat 1 (south-west facing) in the side elevation of the property shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form&nbsp;<span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">in perpetuity.</span>

Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.

Notwithstanding the approved plans,
the development hereby permitted, the proposed refuse (recycling and waste) provisions
shall be stored at all times in the location indicated on the approved plans,
other than on collection days within the designated refuse storage areas as so
agreed. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details submitted, implemented prior to the first occupation and shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.

The development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until the proposed secure cycle parking stores have been installed and made lockable, in accordance with the approved details. The cycle stores shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the development shall be carried out and completed in complete accordance with the submitted&nbsp;<span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">Fire Safety -Proposed Ground, First
&amp; Loft Floor Plan </span><span lang="EN-US" style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3.1-FS-352;&nbsp;</span><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">Reasonable Exception Statement

Safety Statement received April 8th, 2025, submitted as part this application and the declarations made that the development shall accord with&nbsp;Building Regulations standards and Approved Document B
(Fire Safety) Volume 1 – Dwellinghouses&nbsp;to be operated in accordance with and retained in perpetuity.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be used solely for Planning Use Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.  The development proposals, hereby permitted are for 2.No two-bedroom self-contained units, each housing no more than three persons only.
